newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Bashneft H1 97 oil output off 5.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russia Bashneft H1 97 oil output off 5.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Russian oil company AO Bashneft produced 8.19 million tonnes (327,750 barrels per day) of crude in the first half of 1997, down 5.4 percent from the same period last year, Prime Tass news agency said on Monday.
Bashneft, Russia's eighth largest oil company by output, is an independent firm based in the semi-autonomous republic of Bashkiria in southwestern Siberia.
The fall in output during the first half of the year was caused mainly by depletion of oil reserves, Tass said.
Bashneft produced 16.3 million tonnes (326,900 bpd) of oil in 1996, down from 17.7 million (354,000 bpd) in 1995.
